questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The new road ______ through the park last year.
questions.explanation: 主语road是build的承受者，且时间是last year，用一般过去时被动 was built。
questions.evidence: The new road would cut through a park that is used by families every weekend.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The ferry service ______ by the council next month.
questions.explanation: ferry service是review的承受者，next month表示将来，用 will be reviewed。
questions.evidence: The council will vote next month.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal connector: The bridge is narrow. ______, it must be repaired.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系：桥窄，因此必须修。Therefore表示结果。
questions.evidence: Engineers say it must be repaired or replaced within five years.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal connector: ______ the new road would destroy green space, the environmental group opposes it.
questions.explanation: 前后是原因—结果关系，Because引导原因。
questions.evidence: We should not destroy green space for cars.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: The ______ bridge is cheaper to repair.
questions.explanation: existing是现在分词作定语，修饰bridge，表示“现有的”。
questions.evidence: Option A is to repair the existing bridge.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: Bus routes ______ if the bridge is repaired.
questions.explanation: bus routes是change的承受者，条件句主句用将来时被动 will not be changed。
questions.evidence: However, the repair would keep the bridge in its current location, so bus routes would not change.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct causal expression: The ferry was rejected ______ it could carry only 500 people per day.
questions.evidence: This was rejected because it would cost £3 million and carry only 500 people per day.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: The ______ cost is about £8 million.
questions.explanation: estimated是过去分词作定语，表示“估计的”。
questions.evidence: This would cost about £8 million and take 18 months.

title: The Bridge, the Budget, and the Bus Lane · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点有三：1) 被动语态：当主语是动作的承受者时，用 be + 过去分词。例如“The bridge would be closed”表示桥被关闭。2) 因果表达：用 because, so, that means, therefore 等连接原因和结果。例如“Local shop owners are worried because customers might avoid the area.” 3) 分词作定语：单个分词放在名词前，或分词短语放在名词后，起形容词作用。例如“the existing bridge”（现有的桥），“people who do not drive”（不开车的人，这是定语从句，不是分词，但可对比理解）。注意区分新学形式与复习：被动语态和因果表达是新学重点；分词作定语只需基础辨认，不要求复杂分析。

During the work, the bridge would be closed to cars, and traffic would be sent through the town centre.
